C-18.Name: Native print & PDF export via WKWebView print panel (matrix P1; un-gates MAS PDF)
C-18.Summary: window.print() is silently ignored by WKWebView on macOS, so Mark's Print action is dead in the shipped app; PDF export shells out to pandoc (raw markdown — styling lost) and is capability-pruned out of App Store builds entirely (C-15 T-M5). tauri 2.11 / wry 0.55 already ship Webview::print() — the native WKWebView print panel (macOS 11+) with real pagination and a built-in "Save as PDF". C-18 routes Print and Export-PDF through one new backend command that calls it, replacing the pandoc PDF path (pandoc stays for DOCX on desktop) and un-gating PDF on MAS.

Problem.Description: File → Print does nothing on macOS (window.print ignored by WKWebView). File → Export → PDF requires pandoc, exports unstyled markdown-rendered PDF, and is hidden in App Store builds (pandoc is not sandbox-compatible).
Problem.RootCause: The Electron-era print path (window.print + hidden print container) was ported verbatim; WKWebView has no window.print support. The PDF path predates the port and depends on an external binary the sandbox cannot spawn.

Goals.R-1: New backend command mt_print_webview(window label or focused window): runs the webview print panel via tauri Webview::print() on the main thread. No new dependencies. Desktop + MAS builds alike (no binaries, no sandbox surface).
Goals.R-2: Print action: the existing styled print container flow stays; the final window.print() call is replaced by invoke('mt_print_webview'). AMENDED at review: there is no eager cleanup — the print container survives into the panel and is replaced by the next export (the dead 'print-service-clearup' bus wiring was removed; cleanup happens in renderMarkdown and on export error paths).
Goals.R-3: Export PDF: _EXPORT_PDF renders the print-optimized styled HTML into the print container and opens the same native panel (user chooses "Save as PDF" with system pagination and styling). The pandoc PDF branch and its mt_pandoc_status gate are removed; pandoc remains for DOCX export where available.
Goals.R-4: MAS un-gating: applyCapabilityGate no longer prunes file.export-file-pdf (PDF is native now); the exportPandoc capability flag stays reported (informational) but gates nothing until a DOCX command lands. T-M5 capability-gate test updated accordingly.
Goals.R-5: Non-macOS note (AMENDED at review): wry's print is macOS-only and silently no-ops elsewhere, so the command fails fast with an explicit "print panel is macOS-only" error on non-macOS builds; no window.print fallback (it is broken in WKWebView anyway). The product is macOS-first this phase.

Constraints.Constraint: No new crates; uses tauri/wry APIs already pinned in Cargo.lock.
The print panel is the system UI — no custom dialogs; page setup, headers/footers, and "Save as PDF" come from AppKit.

Behavior tests must not require the native dialog: unit pins assert the invoke call and the pruning change; the live dialog is verified by a WKWebView smoke checklist entry (Print opens the panel; Save-as-PDF produces a styled multi-page PDF).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Silent headless print-to-PDF (createPDF) — follow-up if the dialog flow proves insufficient.
DOCX/pandoc changes beyond removing the PDF branch.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit: handleExport 'print' and _EXPORT_PDF invoke mt_print_webview (mocked invoke) with the print container rendered; pandoc PDF path gone; capability gate keeps file.export-file-pdf on MAS-shaped caps (exportPandoc stays an informational flag until a DOCX command lands). The export-settings dialog no longer shows dead page-size/orientation controls for PDF (margins stay).
Rust: mt_print_webview registered, compiles, returns Ok on macOS build; smoke checklist entry recorded (dialog opens from Print and Export-PDF; Save-as-PDF output styled and paginated).
Full suite green; grace lint zero findings on changed files; two sequential reviews clean.

AffectedAreas.M-048: capability gate: PDF no longer pandoc-gated
